result.title: SPRUNN: Structural Proximity for Pruning in Deep Neural Networks
result.summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated significant accuracy across various machine learning tasks. However, these networks suffer from a huge number of parameters and computations, which leads to time-consuming processes. Consequently, parameter pruning approaches have been proposed to compress DNNs and efficiently implement them. The main challenge in pruning is selecting the appropriate parameters for pruning without significantly damaging the accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPRUNN, an algorithmic pruning approach based on the structural proximity criterion for filter pruning in convolutional layers of deep neural networks. Structural Proximity (SP) calculates filter similarity by considering all filters and comparing each one with the others, effectively identifying less important filters for pruning in the convolutional layers. Furthermore, we integrate this approach with fine-grained pruning in Fully Connected(FC)layerstocompresstheDNNsthatinclude both convolutional and FC layers.Toenhancetheaccuracyoftheprunedmodel,weproposealearning rate refinement strategy during the retraining phase. Experimental results demonstrate that SPRUNN achieves significant compression with high accuracy across diverse architectures and datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPRUNN，一种基于「结构邻近度」计算卷积层滤波器两两相似度以判定冗余、并进行滤波器剪枝的压缩方法，辅以全连接层细粒度剪枝与重训练学习率调优。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向 CNN 参数压缩，相似度仅用于剪枝重要性排序，不涉及 VLM 推理中的 latent 状态生成、视觉证据筛选或停止决策，与主线问题缺少实质联系。
